data.body: Finding (2026-11-09 15:45 PST): a spec's top-level `model:` key does not select the model a live `run_eval` uses. It is read only at `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:308` and passed to `validate_scorer` to enforce grader/generator separation; the live run resolves its model through the configured classes (`rebar.toml`). So the before/after prompt-eval comparison is controlled by the upgrade commit (5c89609a0aa, `beaten-natural-grouse`), not by this change. This change keeps the pins truthful. Committed as c984cedba41, stacked on 5c89609a0aa: 28 specs, `model:` line only. Strict validation unchanged (code-quality, gold-only, fails identically on origin/main). Before run (4.x, origin/main 872e7f6c3fd, gate-wrapped, REBAR_EVAL_MAX_CASES=12, 12:33 to 14:45 PST) is recorded; the after run follows on the stacked tree.
